 Harris County sees record-breaking day 1 of early voting 
 ABC13 breaks down the early voting numbers as Harris County sees a record-breaking first day on Monday. By Brandon Hamilton Tuesday, October 20, 2026 2:06PM Share Follow ABC13 on Google HARRIS COUNTY, Texas (KTRK) -- The 2026 midterm elections are off to a record-breaking start in Harris County.
 More than 104,000 people voted in person on the first day, Monday, according to the Harris County Clerk's Office.
 The previous midterm record set in 2018, according to officials, was 63,188.
 Check out ABC13's Early Voting Tracker .
 This record turnout comes as a new Hobby School survey shows what Texans are thinking about heading into the midterm elections.
 The survey found that 60% of voters support allowing any eligible voter to cast a ballot by mail.
